categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Sulian Plastic Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research, production, and sales of automotive plastic fluid pipeline products and related components. Its product portfolio includes automotive fuel pipelines, evaporative emission pipelines, vacuum brake pipelines, new energy vehicle thermal management system pipelines, fluid control components, fast connectors, and plastic fasteners. The company serves over 30 vehicle manufacturers and 100 automotive parts suppliers, with a strong focus on new energy vehicles and related thermal management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in nylon and high polymer materials for automotive fluid pipelines, emphasizing fast connector locking structures, fluid pipeline control valve technology, and manufacturing process innovations. It has developed patented quick connectors and integrated functional flow control joints with sensors and valves. Production employs automated and intelligent manufacturing lines, including MES and PLM systems, with capabilities in precision mold processing, multi-material injection molding, and automated assembly equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive OEMs such as Changan, BYD, Seres, and leading battery manufacturers like CATL and Guoxuan High-Tech. The company serves the automotive industry broadly, including fuel vehicles, hybrid vehicles, new energy vehicles, battery storage systems, and emerging sectors like eVTOL and aviation. Its products are integrated into engine fuel systems, thermal management systems, chassis, and vehicle body components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with manufacturing bases in Chongqing, Jiangsu, Guangxi, Anhui, Hainan, and Zhejiang provinces. It is expanding its presence in the eastern China market and actively pursuing global OEM projects, including European, Japanese, and American automotive brands. Overseas sales remain a small portion but are targeted for growth through global certification and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sulian Plastic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing specialized plastic fluid pipelines and components that are supplied directly to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company emphasizes upstream integration by producing core components such as fast connectors and fluid control valves in-house to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and enhance supply chain autonomy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in new energy vehicle thermal management systems, high-performance fluid pipelines, and integrated fluid control components. It invests heavily in developing lightweight, high-strength polymer materials and quick connector technologies. Strategic initiatives include expanding into battery storage and intelligent computing thermal management markets, leveraging AI and digital manufacturing, and pursuing global certifications to support international market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive plastic fluid pipeline assemblies, fluid control components, and precision injection molded parts. The company uses a 'make-to-order' production model based on OEM orders, with sales recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on product sales to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sulian Plastic is a leading domestic supplier in the automotive plastic fluid pipeline sector, competing with international firms like TI Bondi, Cooper Standard, Norma Group, and domestic peers such as Lingyun and Biaobang. It holds a competitive edge through early adoption of nylon materials, patented quick connector technologies, and strong integration of upstream component manufacturing. The company is recognized for its innovation and quality by major OEMs and battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.24 billion, representing a 22.89% year-over-year increase, driven mainly by new energy vehicle sales growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 122.5 million, a decline of 18.72% due to pricing pressures and reduced government subsidies. The company expanded production capacity by about 40%, with a 51% increase in output. It maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.53 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sulian Plastic emphasizes its pioneering use of nylon and high-performance polymers in automotive fluid pipelines, offering products with superior heat resistance, pressure tolerance, corrosion resistance, and sealing performance. Its patented quick connector technology enables reliable, fast assembly without additional fastening hardware. The company’s integrated design and manufacturing capabilities reduce customer costs and improve product quality, supporting rapid model iteration and customization for new energy vehicles and emerging applications like battery storage and intelligent computing thermal management.
